components.name: Ecosystem control plane
components.summary: Defines run context, policy boundaries, component lifecycle, orchestration, and evidence requirements.
known_limitations: No production execution controller is implemented in this repository yet.

components.name: Delta-matroid decision infrastructure
components.summary: Prototype workbench for delta-matroid algorithms, adaptive portfolio scheduling, candidate merging, feasibility checks, and SQLite history.
known_limitations: The v0.5.0 source package has not yet been imported into this repository.
Runtime budget and cancellation guards are standalone primitives, not enforcement integrated into every controller.
Cancellation and deadline checks are cooperative and cannot forcibly preempt a blocking capability.
StrongPath must retain the verified-lift condition; parity correction alone is not a universally valid lift.
Exact matching verification was exercised only on small instances in the prototype.

validation.scope: Local v0.5.0 artifact only; not this repository's CI.
validation.note: The local suite reported 53 passing tests. This is not evidence of ecosystem-runtime integration.
